title: Spider-Man Could See the Cure. He Couldn’t Reach It.
description: Spider-Man is trapped beneath machinery while Aunt May’s medicine sits out of reach. A recap of Stan Lee and Steve Ditko’s If This Be My Destiny arc, especially The Amazing Spider-Man #33 (1966).
hook: In The Amazing Spider-Man thirty-three, Peter can see Aunt May's cure. He can't escape the wreckage.
payoff: He escapes with the serum. Doctor Connors helps prepare the treatment, and Aunt May gets the medicine that saves her life.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: In The Amazing Spider-Man thirty-three, Peter can see Aunt May's cure. He can't escape the wreckage.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: May is dying from radiation in Peter's own blood. He tried to help her with a transfusion; now he needs a rare serum to save her.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Doctor Octopus's men steal it. Peter follows them to an underwater base, where a fight brings the machinery down on him.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: The cure lands just beyond his hand. Water keeps rising toward his face. He can see a way to save May, but he can't even free himself.
units.onscreen: HE CAN SEE IT. HE CANNOT REACH IT.
units.visual_query: HE CAN SEE IT. HE CANNOT REACH IT.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: For a moment, he almost gives up. Then he thinks of Uncle Ben. He couldn't save Ben. He still has a chance to save May.
units.onscreen: ONE LOSS HE CAN STILL PREVENT
units.visual_query: ONE LOSS HE CAN STILL PREVENT

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: So Peter plants his feet and pushes again. His back begins to straighten. He strains until the machinery clears his shoulders, giving him room to crawl out.
units.onscreen: HE TRIES AGAIN — AND IT MOVES
units.visual_query: HE TRIES AGAIN — AND IT MOVES

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: He escapes with the serum. Doctor Connors helps prepare the treatment, and Aunt May gets the medicine that saves her life.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: All that strength, spent bringing one small bottle back to the person who raised him.
